attaches.why: Both expressions are read cleanly by the existing frame asking what the pipeline must do when a memory is submitted without an explicit id. src-1 supplies the failure case the frame is about — a reproduction of the prod missing-id pattern, a ## level heading with no id field — and src-2 supplies the required behavior under that same question: must not crash, must produce a valid slug. The pair holds the problem and the obligation the frame names; no new reading direction is needed.
